description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyCreated class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and event creation logic.

classes.name: PolicyCreatedTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the PolicyCreated event class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON conversions, and event parsing.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of PolicyCreated are immutable, assuming Policy is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies hashCode and equals implementations for PolicyCreated using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicy
methods.description: Ensures that creating a PolicyCreated instance with a null Policy throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a Policy with null ID throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks that passing null headers during PolicyCreated creation throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that PolicyCreated serializes to JSON as expected.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutRevision
methods.description: Checks JSON output when the revision field is omitted.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of PolicyCreated from JSON string.

methods.name: parsePolicyCreatedEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a PolicyCreated event can be generated, serialized, and correctly parsed back.
